title: How many square inches make one square foot?
description: One foot is twelve inches, so a square foot is a square with each side twelve inches. Its area is twelve times twelve, which is one hundred forty four square inches.
teaching_notes: One idea: a square unit is a square, so its conversion factor is the length factor used twice. Watch for students who say a square foot is only twelve square inches.

source: How many in2 is 1 ft2, using 1 ft = 12 in
video_script.why: The child has changed one square inch to square centimetres by using the length factor twice and now does the same for feet and inches.
video_script.substitution: The book question gives no numbers beyond one foot being twelve inches, so the numbers stay as in the book.
video_script.anchor: a square with each side one foot, which is twelve inches
video_script.payoff_line: One square foot is one hundred forty four square inches.

final_answer.spoken: one hundred forty four square inches

maths_rules: a square foot is a square with each side 12 in
check by rounding: 12 is between 10 and 15; 10 x 10 = 100 and 15 x 15 = 225, so the answer lies between 100 and 225

narration: <bookmark mark='sides'/>Step one, change the sides to inches. The square foot has two sides of twelve inches each.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Step two, the area is side times side, twelve times twelve.
<bookmark mark='rows'/>Picture twelve rows, with twelve square inches in each row.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: check by rounding, 12 is between 10 and 15; 10 × 10 = 100 and 15 × 15 = 225, so the answer is between 100 and 225
narration: <bookmark mark='round'/>Step three, check by rounding. Twelve is between ten and fifteen, so we try both of them.
<bookmark mark='low'/>Ten times ten is one hundred, which is the smaller guess for the area.
<bookmark mark='high'/>Fifteen times fifteen is two hundred twenty five, the bigger guess for the area. The answer should lie between one hundred and two hundred twenty five.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>One square foot is one hundred forty four square inches.
<bookmark mark='near'/>It lies between one hundred and two hundred twenty five, as the check said.
